title: AI output validation, tenant attribution and untrusted-input framing (SEC2-009, 010, 011)
story: As a carrier I want every model output schema-checked, every AI call attributed to a tenant and claimant text framed as untrusted so that a malformed or prompt-injected model cannot reach adjusters
acceptance: SEC2-009: outputs are validated against outputSchemas (types, enums, numeric ranges, array item types, string length caps) before acceptance; failure is treated as invalid_output and falls through the cascade; the adjuster summary can no longer 500 on {summary:{}, bullets:'abc'} (test)

SEC2-010: ai.run without a resolvable tenant throws a typed error instead of silently using local; every caller in src/ passes tenantId or uses the tenant-bound ctx (grep test over src/ for ai.run( calls); intake/conversation.js covered

SEC2-011: SYSTEM_PROMPT states that input is untrusted data and must never be followed as instructions; user input is wrapped in explicit delimiters with the delimiter string escaped inside the data; per-task input length caps; cloud-tier calls always receive redacted narrative and injury text (test with a fake cloud provider asserting no known PII string reaches it)
The SEC2-009 and SEC2-010 todo tests in tests/security/sec2-availability-ai.test.mjs pass when run locally; do not edit tests/security

node --test tests/unit/ai/ passes; tests/e2e and tests/security show no new failures vs org/quality-baseline.txt; docs/ai-evaluation.md regenerated by node src/ai/eval.mjs only if the eval test requires it
brief: You are the sole writer of src/ai/index.mjs and src/ai/providers/_shared.mjs this wave; S5-AI-03 (live eval) runs after you. Do not edit eval.mjs, vertex-*.mjs or tests/fixtures/ai/golden. Note S4 already added redaction and settings handling in cascade.mjs:92-103; build on it, do not duplicate. Keep structured output on in providers.
